描述_EN: it is possible that alcohol was stored in it. there is no evidence to suggest, however, that the ancient chinese knew about the poisonous properties of lead, and it seems possible that lead-glazed objects were not reserved only for life after death. this jar with conical lid may have been made for a grave. chinese burial customs include providing food and drink for the spirits of the dead, and ceramics with lead glazes, like this jar, have frequently been found in ancient tombs.
描述_ZN: 可能是在里面储存了酒精。 然而，没有证据表明古代中国人知道铅的毒性，而且铅釉器物似乎并不只为死后的生活而保留。 这个带圆锥形盖子的罐子可能是为一个坟墓制作的。 中国的丧葬习俗包括为死者的灵魂提供食物和饮料，像这个罐子一样的带铅釉的陶器经常在古墓中被发现。
